law_forced_deviations.reference: kills 'fiber gummies, $25' as a failed remedy, shatters a fiber-gummy tub, then sells capsules
law_forced_deviations.problem: Motilli IS a fiber gummy (3.3g dietary fiber, 3g FOS). Porting this beat verbatim makes the ad kill its own product.
law_forced_deviations.fix: Dismiss COARSE BULK fiber, never fiber as a category. Failed remedy becomes a tub of psyllium husk powder being scooped. Motilli's fiber is then positioned as the opposite kind: low-viscosity soluble, dissolves completely, zero bulk.

law_forced_deviations.reference: magnesium pulls water into the gut + ginger moves food through
law_forced_deviations.problem: Osmotic water-pulling is a COLON action. By Motilli's own canonical frame that is 'the bottom' — porting it would have the ad contradict its own mechanism reveal 20 seconds earlier.
law_forced_deviations.fix: Three real label pillars in the same slots: concentrated celery juice supporting the stomach's own movement (the top), chlorophyll neutralizing sulfur gas off fermenting food, low-viscosity soluble fiber that dissolves completely and adds no bulk.

law_forced_deviations.reference: 'First morning after taking it, I finally went.'
law_forced_deviations.problem: Motilli's own PDP says explicitly this is not an overnight fix. Porting a next-morning claim is a claim the product cannot make.
law_forced_deviations.fix: 'Fourth morning in, I went on my own.' Matches the real on-site Patricia H. testimonial (day 4). Keeps the beat's job and the shot identical.
90-day money-back guarantee, counts even on an opened bottle. Verified live on getmotilli.com/policies/refund-policy this session.
law_forced_deviations.law: reference_motilli_guarantee_30_days (verify-live law). NOTE: the canonical mechanism doc §6 still says '30 days' and is STALE.

law_forced_deviations.reference: real MiraLAX, Tea Well, LAXETTE, Dulcolax, MiraFiber packaging on camera
law_forced_deviations.fix: Keep real trade dress on the failed-remedy inserts (real-props law) but SOURCE or SHOOT them. Do not generate competitor packaging: garbled competitor labels were a named kill-pattern in the 8/18 flop post-mortem.
